title: 7 Red Flags to Check Before You Buy Any Memecoin
excerpt: A repeatable checklist for Solana memecoin launches — liquidity, holders, authority, and social proof.

blocks.text: Charts lag reality. Before you chase a vertical candle, ask structural questions: Who holds supply? Is liquidity locked or removable? Are mint or freeze authorities still active? SyNexus compresses many of these reads into one paste-and-scan flow on the home feed.
Thin liquidity is not a flex
A pool with very little SOL depth can move violently on small sells — and collapse when early wallets exit. Aegis lane watches liquidity integrity and sudden drains that often precede rugs.

When a handful of wallets hold most supply, your buy may become someone else's exit liquidity. Leviathan lane tracks whale concentration and large-wallet flows so you see distribution into strength early.

Broken websites, recycled art, and bot-filled comment sections are common on fast launches. Community reports feed SyNexus scoring — operators flag suspicious tokens from token detail pages when signed in.
